units.source_text: 话虽如此，但若仅此而已的话，更不是什么值得计较的事情了，

en.t: That said, if that was all there was to it, it was even less something worth making an issue of,

units.source_text: 假如他并未作出与其他同事相同的反应，那究竟会不会变得那样固执，还是值得怀疑的。

en.t: and if he had not reacted in the same way as his other colleagues, it is still doubtful whether he would really have become so stubborn.
